driver: The decisive quantity is a per-category total of trips taken from replies to a sample handed out on each day of a fixed window, where a reply comes back only when its trip ends and collection stopped soon after the window closed, so a long trip is among the replies only if it began early enough to end before collection stopped; the categories made of long trips are restored by weighting each reply by the inverse of the share of handout days from which a trip of its length could have come back, not by the return rate of its own handout day nor by the inverse of its length.
driver_concrete: Each candidate market's 2026 service-area trips parked at Brennick are each wave's quarter of transient entries times the market's share of the wave's returned cards, each card weighted by the inverse of the share of the wave's handed cards whose handout day left room for a stay of its nights to end by the last box collection, not raw card shares, nor each handout day's return rate, nor one over nights.
stump: The default path expands each wave's returned cards to its quarter's entries and pitches Washington, New York and Dallas (6,513, 5,121 and 4,829 trips), because a card comes back only when its car leaves and each wave's drop boxes were taken in two days after its last handout, so the cards handed in a wave's later days came back only from short stays, and the two- to four-week winter stays that make up much of Phoenix and Tampa are thinned out of the replies; weighted for when each stay could have come back, Phoenix, Tampa and Washington lead.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who keys every destination to its city market, keeps the service-area ZIPs, drops the served market and expands each wave's returned cards to its quarter's entries pitches Washington, New York and Dallas (6,513, 5,121 and 4,829 trips); reweighting the cards to each handout day's cards handed, by one over the nights, pooling the waves or post-stratifying to each lot's entries lands the same three; only weighting each card by the inverse of the share of handout days from which a stay of its length could have been collected pitches Phoenix, Tampa and Washington.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is a register-based total completed by a supplement survey: the hub's parking entry register counts each quarter's parked trips and the card survey supplies destination, home and party, and survey research's design-based estimator weights each returned card by the inverse of its chance of having been collected, which the fieldwork design sets from the card's handout day and the stay's length; swapped for a share of the replies, the generic estimator of another field, the long stays drop out and the call changes, and without a register, a card that exists only once the stay ends and a collection close the task has nothing to estimate.
layer1: paper cards keyed and coded by the contractor: destinations coded to an airport or a metro code, the answers as written in a separate verbatims file, a few home ZIPs keyed with a plus-four or a space, one keying batch carried twice by the export

airport and metro codes rolled up to city markets (Washington, New York, Chicago and others spanning several airports)
